This page is a test/demo page for the Zo co-browsing feature. Its content is a mock landing page about the Zo platform itself — highlighting features like Instant DuckDB Queries, Web Research Automation, and a Custom Skill Builder, with the hero headline "Build Smarter with Zo."

It exists to verify that the co-browse extension correctly captures and transmits page context (header, hero, feature cards, footer) rather than to convey real product information.
